title: Aureline M5 kernel-state-strip component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the kernel_state_strip family binds inside the frozen M5 notebook-kernel-output component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-notebook-kernel-output-component-matrix.schema.json). A kernel state strip names where a kernel stands in execution and how it is connected so a strip never leaves no-kernel, busy, disconnected, or reconnecting execution state implicit. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
